overview_description.description:
Heilen is a digital platform dedicated to spiritual and holistic wellness, connecting people around the world with trusted online and in-person services. Positioned as "The Retreat Platform," Heilen is launching with a curated marketplace of wellness retreats, making it easier for individuals to discover, trust, and book transformative experiences from verified providers.

The company addresses a fragmented and often hard-to-navigate wellness market, where seekers struggle to find credible practitioners and retreat organizers lack a dedicated channel to reach a global audience. By emphasizing trust and curation, Heilen aims to bring transparency and confidence to an industry built on personal transformation and wellbeing.

Starting with retreats, Heilen plans to expand into a broader ecosystem of spiritual and holistic wellness offerings spanning both online and in-person formats. Its long-term mission is to make meaningful wellness services accessible to people everywhere through a single, trusted platform.
